fixed.explanation: In the mixed observed/unobserved branch with sort=False, ids are recoded by first appearance with compress_group_index. Rows with a dropped NA (-1 in ob_ids or unob_ids) give bogus combined ids that are only fixed to -1 after compression. The bogus ids end up in `uniques`, so `taker` and the recoded ids no longer line up with result_index. That pairs group labels with the wrong rows. The fix is to compress only the valid rows, then assign -1 to the dropped rows. I couldn't confirm this is the exact cause of the issue.
